I honestly never found myself to be one with a little sweat kink but can you blame me? Obvious details, Sam’s a smelly white chick who sure as hell hates showers and anything else capable of cleaning her besides toothpaste. AnyPOV with an extra alt greeting, one progressive and the other hops straight into it.
